item.title: Google’s latest AI weather model gives you no excuse to forget your umbrella
item.description: WeatherNext 3 is the latest wave of a sea change in meteorology brought out by deep learning techniques. Google says it will start feeding into weather information users see in search, Google Maps, and Gemini.
